name: Gästehaus Glätzle
beschreibung: Gästehaus Glätzle in Zöblen is a traditional inn situated in the picturesque Tannheimer Tal. The property greets visitors with a charming rustic atmosphere highlighted by warm, natural wood elements. The guest rooms offer inspiring views of the surrounding mountain scenery. The prime location is tailored for summer hiking adventures as well as memorable winter ski holidays. Among the property highlights are an inviting restaurant featuring regional culinary specialties and a rejuvenating sauna area. The center of Zöblen is comfortably within walking distance. Guests prize the guesthouse as an ideal starting point for excursions across the Tannheimer mountain world.
